Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXV OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXXV OF 1983
AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT BANK (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the
Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th December, 1983]
No. F. 17(1),183-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Agricultural Development Bank (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Agricultural Development Bank Second Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Amendment of section 19, Ordinance IV of 1961

ORDINANCE XXXV OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXXV OF 1983
AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT BANK (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the
Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th December, 1983]
No. F. 17(1),183-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 19, Ordinance IV of 1961.--In the
Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961 (1V of 1961), in section 19, in
sub-section (1), in clause (d), for the proviso the following shall be
substituted, namely :-
"Provided
that, where a loan not exceeding such amount as the Federal Government may, by
notification in the official Gazette, specify is made to an individual
agriculturist, it may be secured by a bond with one or more sureties, as the
Bank may deem necessary.".
